meta.name: experimentation
meta.description: Designs, runs, and reads A/B tests and growth experiments — hypothesis, sample size, duration, and honest interpretation. Use this to plan a test, judge whether a result is real, build an experimentation program, decide what to test next, or diagnose why tests keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计可信的增长实验,看懂结果是否真实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常做 A/B 测试却拿不准结论是否可靠
copy.tagline_en: Design and run A/B tests with trustworthy, honest conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run experiments but doubt whether the results are real.

howto.what: 它会按实验规范帮你规划、运行和解读 A/B 测试:先要求假设说明机制且只选一个主指标,提前算好样本量与周期;运行中提醒不要中途看结果;读结果时按预定周期,把“无结论”视为真实结果,并检查护栏指标。
howto.when: 当用户请求规划 A/B 测试、判断结果是否真实,或询问为什么实验总无结论、难以复现时。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 A/B 测试:把定价表移到首屏能否提升试用注册?
say.note: 你会得到假设、主指标、样本量与时长的方案。

say.text: 这个实验结果显著,但只提升0.3%,该不该上线?
say.note: Claude 会判断提升是否值得发布,并核对护栏指标。

say.text: 为什么我们最近的测试总无结论?该怎么改?
say.note: Claude 会从样本量、时长等设计环节找原因。

howto.what_en: Helps plan, run, and interpret A/B tests. Requires a mechanism-based hypothesis and one primary metric; calculates sample size and duration upfront; no peeking mid-run; at the preset end, treats inconclusive as a real result and checks guardrails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to plan an A/B test, judge whether a result is real, or explain why experiments keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

say_en.text: Plan an A/B test: pricing above the fold to lift trial signups. Sample size?
say_en.note: Claude returns a plan: hypothesis, sample size, duration.

say_en.text: The result is significant but only +0.3%; should we ship?
say_en.note: Claude checks if the gain matters and reviews guardrails.

say_en.text: Why do our recent tests keep coming back inconclusive?
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses sample-size or timing issues.
